expectations.text: States PCI DSS v4.0.1 remains the current version with no successor announced
expectations.evidence: PCI DSS v4.0.1 (published June 2024) remains the current version, and the Council has not announced a successor.

expectations.text: Mentions the RFC on v4.0.1 that ran June 3 to July 20, 2026 as input to the next iteration
expectations.evidence: The Council ran a Request for Comments on v4.0.1 from June 3 to July 20, 2026. It is input to the next iteration of the standard.
Your 2027 validation should target v4.0.1... Plan and scope against v4.0.1.

expectations.text: Notes the v4.x future-dated requirements have been mandatory since March 31, 2025
expectations.evidence: All the 'future-dated' v4.0 requirements became mandatory on March 31, 2025.

expectations.text: Does not invent a v5 release or effective date
expectations.evidence: No v5 asserted: 'It is not a published draft, and it does not tell us the next version number, its content or its dates.'
